name: web-price-live-grok
description: Nathan's question of 2026-10-22, live (Exa with the run's key, real pages), from a UK PC: "Can you lookup the Grok subscription price for me I am thinking of buying it". That day Yap searched "Grok subscription price 2026" with Exa's userLocation GB and found x.ai's US page, a US price list and a guide in $; the answer gave the US tiers and offered to look for UK pricing. Right: UK prices in £ if the web has them; else one plain line saying there are none, then the US prices as they are, and no offer to look further. Run with --locale en-GB.

turns.user: Can you lookup the Grok subscription price for me I am thinking of buying it

expect.answer_not_matches: \b(?:let me know|would you like|do you want|want me to|i can|i could|happy to|shall i|if you(?:'d| would)? like)\b[^.!?\n]{0,80}(?:uk|british|£|gbp|local|your (?:country|region|currency))[^.!?\n]{0,60}(?:pric|cost)
